articles.summary: When it comes to injection-moulding tolerances, those required for medical programmes are among the most demanding. On top of the required precision, manufacturers need to keep in mind quality management, risk, validation, documentation, traceability, contamination control, inspection, change management and long-term repeatability.
articles.title: Choosing an EU-Based ISO 13485 Injection Moulding Partner for Medical Devices

articles.summary: Choosing the right manufacturing approach for an in vitro diagnostic (IVD) consumable starts with the part’s function. Cuvettes, cartridges and sample handling plastics all need to perform reliably within a diagnostic system, but the critical requirements can vary significantly from one component to another.
articles.title: Injection Moulding for IVD Consumables: Cuvettes, Cartridges and Sample Handling Plastics
